_comment: Tier-2 for febio::active_contraction#0, and a CORRECTION to its Signal. The bare active material (no passive solid in a `solid mixture`) reads SUCCESS and then dies with WARNING 'No force acting on the system.', ERROR 'Negative jacobian detected.' — SINGULAR and with no count — then '------- failed to converge at time' and error termination. The claim quoted '8 negative jacobians detected.' and zero completed steps; the plural string never appears and the run completes some steps before dying. The fixture asserts the plural form is ABSENT so the wrong Signal cannot come back. Substance of the claim (element inversion for want of a passive base) stands. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
